umfrageBanner.kurze_frage_zur_zukunft_de: Quick question about the app's future
umfrageBanner.die_zeiterfassung_bleibt_k: Time tracking stays free. But would a stronger AI for the report book be worth something to you? Two questions, no sign-up.
umfForm.zeiterfassung_cloudsync_auswertu:
Time tracking, cloud sync, reports and the PDF export stay free —
                        nothing changes there. Only the AI that writes your report book costs
                        money on an ongoing basis. So this is only about that. The points below are
                        ideas — none of it exists yet.
umfForm.wie_oft_schreibst_du_gerade: How often do you currently write in your report book?
umfForm.was_waere_dir_beim_kiberichtshef: What would be worth money to you for the AI report book?
umfForm.und_wie_oft_wenn_es: And how often, if you got what you checked?
umfForm.eine_antwort_ehrlich_geschaetzt_: One answer — an honest guess, even if nothing changes
umfForm.was_waere_dir_das_im: What would that be worth to you per month?
umfForm.es_werden_nur_diese_vier: Only these four answers are transmitted. No name, no email, no entries. None of it is binding.
umfFeatures.formulierungen_die_du_so_ueb: Wording you can use as-is instead of rebuilding it
umfFeatures.lernt_aus_deinen_bisherigen_: Learns from your previous weeks so it doesn't sound like a machine
umfFeatures.prueft_ob_die_woche_zum: Checks whether the week matches the training framework plan and holds up to your trainer
umfFeatures.ganzen_monat_in_einem_durchl: A whole month in one go instead of week by week
umfFeatures.so_oft_neu_generieren_wie: Regenerate as often as you want, no wait
umfFeatures.die_ki_soll_bleiben_wie: The AI should stay as it is, free
umfDone.das_hilft_mir_bei_der: This helps me decide. Whatever the outcome: time tracking itself stays free.

freigabeModal.normalerweise_scannst_du_s: Normally you just scan their response code with your phone camera. If they sent you the link instead, you can paste it here.
freigabeModal.die_woche_steckt_im_link: The week is contained in the link itself and is not uploaded. An approval locks the entry here — you can always unlock it yourself, but that discards the approval.
